title: Crater Isles
summary: An artillery party round on the terrain world: three grassy islands over sandstone cliffs in a sea; lobbed bombs carve round craters through the soil, the same on every screen, and knock friends into the water.

verified.kit: xgames-kit stream/terrain (worlds/terrain, components/carve, library pack xk-terrain of this branch)
verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from crater-isles, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (a build verify, every build measure; 176 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (CHROME_ARGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl"); tests/terrain-two-players.mjs <dir>: host and joiner over WebRTC hold the same ground after real bomb clicks, a late joiner gets it (6 of 6 steps)
